title: users.account_recovery_requested
description: AccountRecoveryRequested is published by identify when a user with two-factor authentication on, who lost both the authenticator app and every recovery code, asks platform staff to get their account back. The user already passed the first login step (password or OAuth), so identify knows who they are. Only admin consumes it: it keeps the requests that staff reviews in the back-office. Identify allows one pending request per user, so a repeated delivery carries the same RequestID and is harmless. The answer comes back signed as admin.account_recovery_approved or admin.account_recovery_rejected.

event_id.description: Identificador único del evento. Usar para deduplicar (at-least-once).

occurred_at.description: Momento del hecho de negocio, ISO 8601 en UTC.

request_id.description: ID de la solicitud en discordia-identify.

user_id.description: Usuario que pide recuperar la cuenta (ID de discordia-identify).

message.description: Lo que el usuario contó sobre su situación, o vacío si no escribió nada.

requested_at.description: Momento en que se envió la solicitud, ISO 8601 en UTC.
